expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Almost nobody goes to Cao Bang, and Ban Gioc is the best waterfall in the country. That is the whole point of this one.
expert.tip: The road to Cao Bang is slow and winding. Sit in the front if you are prone to car sickness, and go between September and November when the river is full.

summary: Eight days with a run into the far north east: two nights in Hanoi with a Ninh Binh day, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, then two nights at Cao Bang for the tiered curtain of Ban Gioc on the Chinese border river, and a guided half day of the capital before the flight home.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast, dinner at the first hotel and all meals on the cruise boat; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay; the Ban Gioc waterfall day trip; a guided half day tour of Hanoi.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
